selection.caption_selection: shortest eligible original human-written caption; tie by annotation ID
selection.image_selection: sort eligible images by SHA-256 of seed:official_split:image_id; take first valid unique images

training_prompts: 請說明圖片中的主要物體與動作。
這張照片呈現了什麼場景？

limitations: Human captions can still contain omissions or annotation errors.
Keyword filtering and perceptual hashes do not prove perfect visual grounding.
Human-written tags are partial; unlisted objects must not automatically be called absent.
Local split separation cannot rule out these public images occurring in model pretraining.

rights.image_rights: COCO-CN uses MS-COCO photographs. Image rights remain with original owners; do not relabel every photo MIT.
